h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bahraich

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bahraich

c: Bahraich is a district town in the terai belt of Uttar Pradesh, near the Nepal border, where the monsoon is heavy and the ground stays soft for weeks after the rains. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bahraich to schools, colleges, municipal parks, government campuses and residential colonies. Our Fun Fitness range is made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,270 km away, and delivered by road.

Soft, wet ground affects how machines are fixed. In most terai sites we recommend grouting, where each post is set in a concrete footing deep enough to stay firm when the soil around it is saturated. Self-standing machines need a solid concrete or paved base. It also helps to raise the gym area slightly above the surrounding ground. Once the base is right, galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle the rain and humidity well. Share the plot size and photos, and we will advise on the base for each machine.

richText.heading: Grouted machines for soft terai ground

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on soft, wet ground?
items.a: Yes, with grouting. Each post is set in a concrete footing that stays firm when the soil is wet. Raising the area slightly also helps it drain after rain.
Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory and send the order by road. Our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it on site.

items.q: How do we get a layout drawing?
items.a: Send the plot size, a few photos and the number of machines you want to sales@funplaysystems.com. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the clear space marked.
